text: One function in intentsvcs names the running tree in the contract's order, brew when the manifest says `managed_by: brew`, opt when its `tool` is intent, dev when the root is a git work tree with no manifest, unknown otherwise, reading the manifest before the path and answering brew for a manifest-less keg whose root resolves under the opt link; every caller asks it, and doctor fails on unknown and on a dev tree whose git cannot be read.
